semanticChecks: Four cerebral lobes and their main roles retained, including source-diagram smell/emotion/motivation/will and taste/understanding/judgment associations with explicit nonexclusive/non-diagnostic limitation. Cognitive memory/language/recognition/action/planning/sequence functions distinguished; difficulty with one task is not loss of all abilities. Familiar-face ability and step support retained. Dementia has multiple causes, not one forgetful event or age-only dismissal; professional assessment and individual plan/facility limits retained.

Age-related versus dementia forgetting comparison retains part-versus-whole event, course, awareness and life impact as inquiry clues. Dementia may include awareness/anxiety; awareness cannot exclude it. Cause-dependent degree/progression, history/routine/remaining ability/motivation, short clear speech/response time, no convenience-based rearrangement or forced identical activities retained. Emotional validation distinct from asserting unconfirmed event; no arguing down/public memory test, facts checked together and responsible staff informed.

Alzheimer atrophy/new-memory difficulty/possible gradual changes versus vascular lesion-dependent uneven abilities/possible stepwise change/hemiplegia/aphasia retained. Lewy-body visual hallucination/fluctuation/Parkinson-like symptoms and possible REM behavior disorder retained with time/behavior records to medical professionals, not one-feature diagnosis. Ordinary REM knowledge distinct from observed sleep behavior; alpha-synuclein accumulation not occipital-atrophy-only. Frontotemporal behavior/personality/language/repetition variability retained; no label-based personality assumptions.

Alzheimer medication may aim to slow progression, with differing purpose/effect/response; no all-drugs/all-dementia promise. Physician medication decisions and careworker reporting/individual-plan support explicit.

Core memory/orientation/executive/understanding/judgment difficulties linked to living examples with individual variation. BPSD anxiety/irritability/hallucination/delusion/restlessness/repeated walking has physical/environmental/interpersonal/emotional context; peripheral label is not lesser importance. Strong words/hitting may reflect fear/pain/poorly communicated elimination urge. Actual behavior/before-after/persondifficulty checked, walking purpose not predetermined. No independent medication increase or restraint by symptom label; urgent abnormalities interrupt routine interview for help.

Kidney urine production, renal pelvis/ureter/bladder/urethra route and different connections retained. Cerebrum/brainstem/spinal-cord roles, bladder storage distinct from production, urge/orientation/mobility separate abilities retained. About500mL capacity and about200–300mL urge are learning references, never universal thresholds or reason to delay toileting. Male/female structural differences and prostate do not determine mobility/help wishes. Person request/current state/individual support and responsible-staff reporting retained.

Urine daily1,000–1,500mL, high2,000–3,000mL-or-more, low300–500mL-or-less kept as source-specific learning references, not universal diagnoses; polyuria/oliguria terms not diagnostic authority. Daily4–6 examples/day8-or-more/night2-or-more attention references retained. Frequency separate from volume; collection period/intake/drugs/disease/climate/baseline/medical evaluation conditions retained. Half-day600mL is not full-day measured volume and cannot fabricate unmeasured half to1,200mL.

Urine pale-yellow-to-clear source example and observed cloudiness/red/dark-brown changes retained without color-only cause diagnosis. Source table odorless versus strong-ammonia claim remains attributed to table; actual sample timing/conditions and other changes/personcomplaints retained, no smell-only infection conclusion. Stool daily1–2/brown references qualified by food/disease/individual baseline and form/amount/color. Red/black/whitish recorded specifically, no color-only bleeding diagnosis. Distress/abnormalities report without waiting for complete notes; no general-number-based water/drug changes.

Diaper precheck/explanation/consent/privacy/supplies/bedheight/waterproofsheet and minimal exposure retained. Side/supine/hip lift only within ability/state/individual plan; example sequence waterproof pad in side position, return supine, capable hip lift/pants down, then tape opening retained with permission/feasibility and no forced movements.

Genital washing temperature/person comfort and facility method retained, skin folds/no rubbing/gentle drying. Source-explicit female washing direction urethral-to-anal, no dirty return and clean surface/material each wipe retained. Dirty diaper inward fold, clean/used separation, no contamination of new diaper/clean space; dirty-to-clean glove removal/handhygiene/newgloves if needed. Source posture-return/diaper-removal combination not authorization for contamination; trained method and simplified-diagram limitation explicit.

2–3finger abdominal/thigh gap remains teaching example rather than universal product measurement; actual product type/size/instructions/skin/personsensation combined. No leak alone does not establish comfort/fit: rolled edge/wrinkle/tightness pain and possible pressure injury checked, position/skin/garments/sheets adjusted per product. Abnormality/pain to responsible staff; itch and other causes not independently diagnosed. Capability/permission before hip lift for clothing, no difficult forced action, final condition/comfort/safe bed/surroundings/cleanup/handhygiene/ventilation without chilling retained. Text alone not skill acquisition, facility training and plan required.

All7readings translated in full from effective source with actors/unknowns/time/units and case conditions preserved. All7questions retain exact indices/four distinct options/four specific reasons. All7artcaptions preserve scene-only and no diagnostic/completion-proof limits.
